Probe: a whole-library search that comes back empty needs a server, and the board draws the FAILED scope band over it, which needs a server that half-answers. The fixture sets `serverPage` + `searchState:"failed"` so the band renders — `searchState` alone does not, and a case that only set the query would have been measured as this board while showing a different screen.

WIDTH IS NOT JOINABLE ANYWHERE ON THIS PANEL, and it costs this recipe three targets. Figma strokes do not consume layout; CSS borders do. Board 144:2 gives the panel a 1px --bk-gray-100 edge (joined, and passing), so every w-full child of it measures 278 against a board that writes `w-[280px]` on the same child. Skipped on that ground: 782:4399, the No results block itself — its gap-10 / pt-36 / pb-32 / px-24 ARE built, they simply cannot be asserted without its 280; and 1314:20 / 1314:21, the scope band, which is unjoinable twice over (280 again, and a 190 text-frame auto-width). The band's two text children 782:4400 / 782:4401 carry colour and no width, so they are what anchors the state.

The scope band's own type is authority=open: board 1313:12 says 11/16 accent, this board's 1314:21 says 13/20, and 43 vs 51 for the band height. Two boards disagree, so the code keeps 11/16. Both boards DO agree it is Inter and not mono, and that the informative state is accent — both conformed.

Also on screen and drawn by no board: the Load more row. It is gated on the server having more than is loaded, which is exactly true here and is the honest way out of a search that matched nothing locally.
